Export a note with its colours, fixes from Obsidian's plugin review, and the server on a release page of its own.

## What changed since 0.6.3

- **Export a note with its colours (off by default).** Turn on Settings → Augmented View → Export → *Export colours*, and the command *Export this note with its colours* (also in a note's file menu) writes a new note, `<name> (colours).md`, next to the note or in a folder you choose. Each coloured sentence is wrapped in a marker, `~={#FFD2D2, Claims}…=~`, or, if you prefer, `<mark data-colour="#FFD2D2" data-category="Claims">…</mark>`; phrase colours can be included too. The colours are the ones the note shows (its colour code, the sensitivity, the rules); any the server has not computed yet are computed first. The note itself is never changed, and the markers keep code, maths, links, footnotes, lists, tables and block ids intact. See [Exporting a note's colours](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view/blob/main/docs/colour-codes.md#exporting-a-notes-colours).
- **Styles:** the floating key folds without `!important` in the stylesheet (the plugin clears and restores the height you gave it), the settings' contents column uses `gap`, and marks use the unprefixed `box-decoration-break`.
- **The server has its own release page.** This release carries only the plugin's files, `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`, as Obsidian asks. The server programs, their checksums and licence files are on [server-0.6.2](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view/releases/tag/server-0.6.2); the server is unchanged since 0.6.2, so an installed one needs nothing.
- **Built and attested by GitHub Actions.** The three files are built from the tagged source and carry build-provenance attestations: check one with `gh attestation verify main.js --repo Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view`.

## Requirements and installation

As in 0.6.2: Obsidian 1.8.7 or later, desktop only, and the model server for your computer. Step by step: [Installation](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view/blob/main/docs/installation.md).
